name: Esqueleto Explosivo 3
review:
Esqueleto Explosivo 3 moves the band to a 5x5 cluster grid with avalanches, Explosivo Wilds and stacking Mucho Multipliers.

Thunderkick rates it High volatility, with a 7,500x cap. The published RTP is 94.22%.

Moving the series to a cluster grid changes the rhythm: wins come in bigger groups, and each avalanche feeds the Mucho Multiplier. The mariachi soundtrack is as catchy as ever.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
